review: Viewed all seven guide checkpoints. One complete recognizable cup follows raw group00 up/right/down path; original site is clear. First RGB is byte-identical to model start image. Proximal forearm absent in this guide but receives zero local prior weight; it is synthesized independently. Cup uses sparse-anchor affine projection; local wrist/gripper use their own projected surface. Small local approximation errors documented in preparation.json. Control is byte-identical to H2.
